verdict.rationale: Lago is a billing platform, so payment-method recovery is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents no network account updater, no backup payment methods, and no hosted update-payment page. The dunning agent and cash-collection filters address chasing overdue invoices, a related but different capability, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, expiring or replaced cards update themselves — network account updater, backup payment methods, and hosted update-payment pages
